svg.title: Process flowsheet: feed, reactor, flash separator and recycle loop
svg.desc: Orthographic process flow diagram drawn as sectioned equipment. Fresh feed (stream 1) meets the recycle in a static mixer, passes down through a fixed-bed catalytic reactor, is cooled in a single-pass shell-and-tube cooler against counter-current cooling water (supply in at the bottom, return out at the top), and is split in a flash drum. Liquid leaves as product (stream 6); vapour rises to a tee where a small purge (stream 7) leaves through a control valve and the rest is recompressed and recycled (stream 8) to the mixer.
